description: A seven-union coordination announced a one-hour warning strike across Sarajevo Canton workplaces for 22 February over a proposed 120 KM wage increase. The opened contemporaneous report is dated 18 January and does not establish whether the strike occurred, whether workers gathered publicly, or the number at any single site. Do not convert 22,000 workers affected or represented into attendance.
required_followup: Locate contemporaneous or retrospective reports after 22 February, preferably local Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian and union or government sources, establishing occurrence, form (work stoppage vs. public assembly), site, simultaneous count, demands and outcome.

description: A Radnički glas podcast mentions the mining federation's opposition to decisions threatening jobs at Kreka and Zenica and a demand to reverse them, but its body describes readiness to fight rather than an actual public gathering in February. The stated 2,700+ figure refers to jobs at risk, not attendees.
required_followup: Seek distinct local reporting for any miners' gathering or march in Bosnia during February; do not infer action from the union statement or workers' count.

description: Fifteen open-web search calls in Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian, Serbian Cyrillic, English and German returned rendered results across national and local queries; surfaced most clearly a planned Sarajevo Canton warning strike and out-of-month reports. This is not a systematic news-archive/LexisNexis search. The current month ledger does not include a clean historical access inventory; known publisher/source holds remain in force.
required_followup: Independent review and further local archival/retrospective searches for February actions across Sarajevo Canton, Republika Srpska, Tuzla, Zenica, Mostar, Bihać and other regions/sectors. Do not claim that no other events occurred.

description: An official Sarajevo Canton search result headline suggests the government and unions agreed to a 100 KM wage supplement, potentially relevant to the Feb. 22 scheduled strike. The fresh exact-URL open returned a tool TimeoutError before any body text; this is a technical failure, not a site denial. No retry was made, and the search snippet is not treated as body evidence.
required_followup: If needed, use a distinct permitted official/local source for the agreement date and its relation to the warning strike; do not repeat the timed-out URL request.
